newsitem.title: USA: AVIC Group buys stake in Chinese network.
newsitem.headline: AVIC Group buys stake in Chinese network.

text.p: AVIC Group International Inc said on Wednesday it has acquired a 31 percent stake in a joint venture company that is building a cellular network in China's Hebei province.
Parties to the joint venture are NTT International Corp, a subsidiary of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone and Hebei United Telecommunications Equipment Co.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed. The company said it has received all necessary government approvals for the acquisition.
The company said it expects commercial operations in
Shijiazhuang, the capital of Hebei, to begin in October, three months ahead of schedule.

When complete, the first phase of the project will provide service to 70,000 subscribers in Hebei's 11 largest cities, which has a population of more than 50 million people. Further construction is designed to expand the network to 200,000 subscribers by 2000.
